title: Answer submission
description: The minimal structured output every implementation returns for a catalog question (ADR 0005, DESIGN.md §6.4): a natural-language answer + key numeric value(s) + optional provenance. `behavior` reports what the implementation did (every catalog question expects `answered`).

question_id.description: The catalog question id (spec/questions/catalog.yaml). Ties the submission to its gold answer.

answer.description: Natural-language answer. For clarification/refusal behaviors, the question asked or the reason to refuse.

key_values.description: The key numeric value(s) graded against gold. The exact per-question shape is declared in catalog.yaml's `grading` block (set_key/id_key/value_keys) with a worked example under spec/questions/examples/; empty {} when behavior is a clarification request or a refusal (grading: behavior-only).

behavior.description: What the implementation did. Every catalog question expects `answered`; the other values let an implementation report that it qualified its answer, asked for clarification, or declined over data quality.

provenance.description: Optional: the governed metrics/dimensions/filters/entities used to produce the answer.
